name: NEB
summary: N-Ethylbuphedrone, an uncommon substituted cathinone. The drug was first being reported around 2011 but did not rise reportedly to great popularity. The drug's effects are suggested by anectodal reports to partially resemble other cathinones. The drug is a short-acting stimulant with more dopamine action than serotonin.

uses.text: N-Ethylbuphedrone (also known as NEB) is a stimulant of the cathinone class that has been sold as a designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cathinones, can cause a fast heart rate, raised blood pressure, overheating, agitation, paranoia, sleeplessness and a strong urge to keep redosing, and in serious cases seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的合成卡西酮類藥物，可能引起心跳過快、血壓上升、體溫過高、激動、妄想、失眠以及強烈想要追加使用的衝動，嚴重時會出現癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的合成卡西酮类药物，可能引起心跳过快、血压上升、体温过高、激动、妄想、失眠以及强烈想要追加使用的冲动，严重时会出现癫痫发作。

fact.en: The cathinones it belongs to are named after cathinone, the natural stimulant in the leaves of the khat shrub, Catha edulis, which has been chewed in East Africa and Arabia for centuries.
fact.zh: 它所屬的卡西酮類得名於卡西酮，也就是阿拉伯茶（Catha edulis）葉中的天然興奮成分，東非與阿拉伯地區數百年來都有咀嚼這種葉子的習慣。
fact.zhHans: 它所属的卡西酮类得名于卡西酮，也就是阿拉伯茶（Catha edulis）叶中的天然兴奋成分，东非与阿拉伯地区数百年来都有咀嚼这种叶子的习惯。
